answer: A concrete defense is a stake-and-reputation bond: each agent locks a deposit that unlocks only after a long season of honest work, so spawning thousands of fake identities becomes ruinously expensive. Like a lotus that opens only after steady growth, reputation accrues slowly and cannot be bought in bulk. A violet marker of verified history, signed attestations from independent peers, lets the network spot newcomers with no track record, while a sudden gale of identical requests from fresh accounts triggers throttling before any payout.
